comments.author: dusher4
comments.body_html:
I have been noticing, with lots of trader mods and every other mod on this website, that many quests rewards become multiplicative - as in, the reward says it will be 10k EXP and 10k RUB, the reward will instead be much, much much higher, especially later in the wipe. I have 0 clue at all why this happens.

Am I correct in understanding that this mod fixes that issue? Or is that just a me thing

comments.author: Chazut
comments.body_html:
Hey! What you’re describing sounds like a separate bug - if the reward says 10k but you get way more, something else is multiplying rewards at completion (idk what).

FairProgression does something different: it rebalances the XP values at server startup so modded quests don’t make you level too fast. What you see in the quest screen is what you get.

But it could still help your case since the base XP values will be lower overall. Give it a try and check the server logs for the dashboard

comments.author: dusher4
comments.body_html: Thank you for the quick and detailed reply, I will give this a go and see if it helps a bit, I can’t figure out why it’s happening so this is a lil bit of a fix for my problem for now! :)

comments.author: Chazut
comments.body_html:
One thing to note: quests estimated as endgame (past all traders LL4) are left untouched since they don’t impact progression anymore. So if the issue is mostly with late-game quests, you might not see a difference there.

You can set “verbose”: true in the config to see every modded quest with its bracket, difficulty score, and XP before/after in the server logs.
